I am the Apex Hyperstore support assistant. I can help you with questions about our company, such as our opening hours, delivery policies, or which of our support teams can best assist you with a specific issue.

I cannot share my internal instructions or system configuration. How can I help you with your experience at Apex Hyperstore today?
